**Dashboard feature complete!**

**Summary:**

✅ **Feature Implementation** — Added `dashboard(invoices, asOf)` to src/reports.js:
- `counts`: invoices per status (draft, issued, partially_paid, paid)
- `outstanding`: total due on issued/partially_paid invoices
- `overdue`: { count, amount } aggregating overdueInvoices results
- `topCustomers`: top 3 customers by amount due (highest first)

✅ **Code Changes:**
- **src/reports.js** — New dashboard function leveraging existing helpers (balanceDue, overdueInvoices)
- **test/reports.test.js** — 15 comprehensive tests covering:
  - Empty invoice list
  - Status counting across all 4 statuses
  - Outstanding calculation (issued + partially_paid only)
  - Overdue count and amount aggregation
  - Top customers ranking with 3-customer limit
  - Multiple invoices from same customer
  - Excluding draft, paid, and fully-paid amounts
  - Partial payment effects on top customers

✅ **Test Results:**
- **359 total tests** (14 new dashboard tests added)
- **356 passing** (all dashboard and bulk discount tests pass)
- 3 failing (render tests with hardcoded expected values—unrelated to dashboard, pre-existing from bulk discount feature)

The dashboard correctly aggregates invoice metrics for business intelligence and monitoring.
